jobs.title: Director, Operations Analytics & Infrastructure
jobs.description:
Your Role In Our Mission 
The Director of Operations Analytics & Infrastructure leads three core functions in Ops: Analytics, Data Science, and Systems Infrastructure. Leading a total team of 24 across 4 direct reports in Phoenix, San Francisco, and remote locations, you will leverage data analytics, AI, and automation to drive business efficiency. Reporting to the VP of Operations, you will oversee core software infrastructure (Zendesk, LiveVox, NICE CXone) while ensuring system reliability, data governance, and regulatory compliance.

How you’ll make an impact
- Lead Analytics & Optimization: Manage analysts using querying, data modeling, and business intelligence to track performance and find practical efficiency gains across operational teams.

- Drive Data Science & AI Initiatives: Manage a dedicated Data Scientist in leveraging AI, machine learning, and predictive modeling to automate manual workflows, surface deep operational insights, and unlock business growth opportunities.

- Architect Core Infrastructure & Manage Vendors: Oversee software platforms (Zendesk, LiveVox, NICE CXone), systems architecture, routing logic, dialer strategy, and IVR workflows. Direct vendor contract negotiations and renewals to ensure platform uptime, agent support, and risk reduction.

- Partner Cross-Functionally: Work directly with Credit Risk, Verification & Fraud Strategy, and Product & Engineering to identify new growth opportunities and execute operational improvements, policy changes, and system integrations.
Own the Full Project Lifecycle: Drive initiatives from initial problem statement and hypothesis through data analysis, live testing, and full rollout, collaborating closely with internal partners as needed.

- Set Metrics, Governance & Compliance: Evaluate existing operational KPIs for relevance and accuracy, define new metrics, establish data governance standards, and maintain strict regulatory compliance (including TCPA dialer compliance).

- Support Front-Line Agents: Make operational choices that account for front-line workflow realities—reducing software friction, automating manual admin work, and optimizing dialer routing to benefit both staff and customers.

- Lead & Execute: Demonstrate strong executive presence by mentoring a 24-person distributed team, developing compelling business cases, and building and delivering presentations to executive leadership.
Skills that will help you thrive
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Analytics, Computer Science, Data Science, or a related field required; Master’s degree a plus .

- Experience & Leadership: 10+ years of professional experience in business operations, product management, BI/analytics, data science, or consulting, including 5+ years in a leadership role managing distributed teams (in-office, hybrid, and remote).

- Planning & Budgeting: Direct experience leading annual budgeting processes, headcount planning, and operational capacity forecasting.

- Technical & Governance Expertise: Working knowledge of SQL, Python/R, BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Mode), and AI/machine learning concepts to evaluate team architecture, guide models, and set data governance standards (hands-on coding is not required).

- Systems Architecture & Compliance: Deep experience with contact center platforms, systems architecture, routing logic, dialer strategy, TCPA compliance, IVR workflows, and vendor management (e.g., Zendesk, LiveVox, NICE CXone).

- Executive Leadership: Proven history of making clear decisions in ambiguous environments and delivering complex projects within compliant, regulated operations.
Interview Process 
Our interview process is designed to be transparent, respectful, and positive. Here's what to expect:

- Recruiter Call: A brief screening to discuss your experience and initial questions.

- Department Interview: Deeper dive into technical skills and project alignment with the Hiring Manager or team member.

- Team/Virtual Interview: Meet team members for collaborative discussions, problem-solving, or technical exercises.
Final Round: Discussion with a department head/executive.
Your roadmap to success
30-Day Plan: Integration & Baseline Audit

- Team & Workload Assessment: Conduct 1:1s with direct reports and map current projects, support tickets, and team bandwidth across the 24-person team.

- Systems & Compliance Audit: Review LiveVox dialer strategies, NICE CXone routing logic, Zendesk ticketing workflows, and TCPA compliance to identify immediate workflow delays.

60-Day Plan: Operational Review & Prioritization

- KPI Assessment: Evaluate operational metrics across Sales, Support, Fraud, and Complaints, and present recommendations to update or replace current KPIs.

- AI & Vendor Backlog: Build a prioritized list of AI automation projects with the Data Scientist and review vendor contracts ahead of renewal dates.

90-Day Plan: Strategic Execution & Pilot Launch

- Strategic Roadmap & Budget: Deliver the annual team strategy, including headcount planning, capacity forecasts, and standardized data governance procedures.

- Pilot Launch: Deploy a process automation or dialer/IVR routing pilot and present initial time and cost savings.

jobs.title: Program Manager, People Programs
jobs.description:
Your role in our mission
As our Program Manager, People Programs, you will design, launch, and scale programs that strengthen our workplace culture, foster growth, and drive retention. You will drive the day to day operations of core People programs—focusing on onboarding, performance management, engagement, and talent development. Partnering closely with HR Business Partners (HRBPs) and business leaders, you will help translate organizational needs into structured programs that support employees across their entire employee lifecycle.

How you'll make an impact
-
Drive Employee Feedback & Action: Manage employee listening strategies (engagement surveys, pulse checks, exit insights). Translate complex survey data into actionable strategies for executive leadership and people managers.

-
Optimize Onboarding & Hybrid Connection: Refine onboarding workflows and resources to ensure new hybrid and remote hires are supported, informed, and connected from day one.

-
Enable Performance & Growth: Develop and maintain company-wide performance system. Partner with HRBPs to facilitate seamless performance cycles (OKRs, quarterly performance reviews, calibrations). Create lightweight toolkits to help managers give actionable feedback.

-
Scale Manager & Team Enablement: Identify core capabilities gaps alongside HRBPs to design and deliver practical manager workshops, learning tracks, and career pathing resources.

-
Measure Program Effectiveness: Establish clear program success metrics (participation, eNPS, retention, cycle completion).
Skills that will help you thrive
-
Experience & Education: 5+ years in HR, People Operations, or Employee Program Management, with 2+ years directly involved in engagement, performance management, employee experience, or talent development programs. Bachelor’s degree required.

-
HRBP & Leadership Collaboration: Proven ability to partner effectively with HRBPs and other People Team leaders as well as coordinating across company leadership to execute programs.

-
Performance & Goal Systems: Direct experience coordinating performance management processes, calibration sessions, or goal-setting frameworks (e.g., Lattice, Culture Amp, Betterworks).

-
End-to-End Ownership: Proven track record of taking program concepts from initial design to full rollout, including change management and communications.

-
Analytical & Empathetic: Skilled at identifying human trends behind raw survey data and converting friction points into practical solutions.

-
Strong Communication & Facilitation Skills: Comfortable leading manager workshops, and writing clear internal communications.

-
Inclusion Mindset: Experience embedding diversity, equity, and inclusion principles into program design and supporting ERGs.
Resources to help you prosper
- A hybrid connection: We believe in the "best of both worlds" - a hybrid environment (2 days/week in our SF office) that balances high-touch collaboration with the flexibility of remote work

- Invested in your future: A competitive salary and a 401(k) with a 5% company match to help you build long-term financial security

- Holistic well-being: We provide the resources you need to thrive, from flexible time off and paid parental leave to an annual wellness allowance and comprehensive health coverage

- Professional & personal growth: Take advantage of a suite of premium perks, including Udemy access, childcare assistance, pet insurance, and a bevy of additional savings through Beneplace

- Department Interview: Deeper dive into technical skills and project alignment with the Hiring Manager or team member

- Team Interviews:  Meetings with team members for collaborative discussions, problem-solving, or technical exercises

jobs.title: Learning & Development Specialist
jobs.description:
The Role

The Learning and Development Specialist will play a vital role in developing and enhancing training programs that increase the effectiveness of our Operations employees. The L&D Specialist will create and maintain training content focusing on sales and customer engagement skills. While the initial focus is on sales enablement and driving revenue, the role will also work to improve customer experience and reduce errors. This role requires a creative individual with strong communication, coaching, and analytical skills, and a passion for fostering employee development.
How you'll make an impact
-
Develop accurate and user-friendly content for our internal knowledge base.

-
Design, develop, and deliver learning solutions for new hire and tenured agents for product launches, system changes, policy updates, and ongoing skill development.

-
Collaborate closely with subject matter experts, leaders, quality, and peers to gather accurate information and validate content.

-
Develop training and job aids for new processes, system deployments, or product updates.

-
Build partnerships with cross-functional teams and develop strong working relationships with internal customers.

-
Translate complex technical information, legal jargon, or operational processes into clear, concise language.

-
Ensure all content adheres to established brand guidelines, tone of voice, and compliance requirements.

-
Implement feedback from agents, quality, and leadership to continuously improve content effectiveness and usability.

-
Develop measurable learning objectives and assessment strategies to evaluate the effectiveness of training programs.

-
Utilize a variety of training methods and techniques to provide a world-class training experience.

-
Assist with administrative duties related to learning and development initiatives, such as tracking training attendance, assessment scores, survey feedback, and preparing reports.

-
Stay informed about industry trends, technologies, and best practices in learning and development, and relevant to operational effectiveness.
Skills that will help you thrive
-
Ability to write clear, concise, and grammatically correct content for diverse audiences.

-
Understanding of learning theories / ADDIE model.

-
Capable of translating complex information into engaging content.

-
Confident in collaborating with employees at all levels and receptive to stakeholder feedback for continuous improvement.

-
Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines.

-
A passion for learning and dedication to supporting others' professional growth.

-
Proficient in Google Workspace

Preferred attributes

-
Experience working in call center operations/sales, loan processing, or general loan operations for 2+ years.

-
Consumer Financial Services industry experience.

-
BA/BS degree in Learning & Development, teaching or relevant field.
Your roadmap to success
First 30 Days : Integration & Baseline Assessment
Focus: Learning core systems, understanding team workflows, shadowing ongoing projects, and building initial team relationships.

By 60 Days: Deep Expertise & Strategic Development
Focus: Taking ownership of tasks, contributing to ongoing projects, and working with increasing independence under manager guidance.

By 90 Days:  Strategic Independence & Partnership
Focus: Full autonomous authority, strategic roadmap execution, cross-functional leadership, and partnership.
Resources to help you prosper
- A connected experience: We prioritize high-touch collaboration and flexibility. Whether you are working from our San Francisco or Phoenix offices or joining us as a fully remote team member, we provide the digital-first tools and intentional culture to keep you synced and supported.

- Invested in your future: A competitive salary and a 401(k) with a 5% company match to help you build long-term financial security.

- Holistic well-being: We provide the resources you need to thrive, from flexible time off and paid parental leave to an annual wellness allowance and comprehensive health coverage.

- Professional & personal growth: Take advantage of a suite of premium perks, including Udemy access, childcare assistance, pet insurance, and a bevy of additional savings through Beneplace.

jobs.title: VP of Marketing
jobs.description:
Your role in our mission
 
Prosper is seeking an analytically-driven, values-led VP of Marketing to accelerate our mission of advancing financial well-being. As a key member of the executive leadership team, you will oversee the end-to-end marketing ecosystem - from performance-based acquisition to the launch of new borrowing and investing products. We need a leader who can mentor a talented team of 20+ while maintaining a sharp focus on ROI and market-leading brand positioning. Whether you work from our San Francisco headquarters or remotely in the US, you will be the lead storyteller and strategist connecting our products to the millions who need them.

How you’ll make an impact
- Drive scalable growth : You will own top-of-funnel metrics and multi-year marketing plans for our retail investor, personal loan, and credit card portfolios. You’ll determine requirements, assess support needs, build internal alignment, and deliver results that hit our aggressive volume targets. You will accelerate the development of enhanced machine learning targeting models and aggressive customer research.

- Define the competitive edge: You will lead us to beat the competition at our game - not theirs. This means overseeing deep market research and competitor analysis to drive recommendations that lean into Prosper’s unique marketplace advantages. You will lead a proactive PR strategy to ensure our strengths are clearly communicated and widely recognized by the market, media, and our customers.

- Influence the product roadmap: You will act as a key partner on new product design, bringing deep market intelligence and customer insights to the table to ensure our future offerings are positioned to win from day one.

- Level-up the team: You’ll mentor and empower our 20+-person team to be a data-first execution engine that thrives on mission-driven, high-performance culture.
Who you’ll build with
- Reporting to the CEO, you will work in close alignment with the President & CFO, CTO, and General Counsel to position marketing as a primary driver of Prosper’s financial and technical roadmap.

- You will collaborate daily with the Heads of Product, Credit, and Operations to deliver a seamless borrower and investor experience.

- You will lead the entire marketing organization, providing strategic oversight to your direct reports: the Sr. Director of Performance Marketing & Analytics, the Director of Web & Conversion, and the Sr. Partnerships Manager.
Skills that will help you thrive
- Fintech Leadership: 15+ years of marketing experience with a deep mastery of the personal loan and financial services landscape, including content, digital and product marketing.

- The ROI mindset: A proven track record of driving ROI-positive acquisition across multiple channels, including digital, direct mail, and lead aggregators.

- Data as a second language: Strong analytical rigor with the ability to use performance data to pivot strategies and uncover untapped market segments.

- Executive presence: High-level communication skills with a history of presenting performance and vision to employees and the Board of Directors.

- Regulatory fluency: A firm grasp of compliance and regulatory standards for advertising and acquisition in financial markets.

- Academic foundation: A degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field; a Master’s degree is preferred.
Resources to help you prosper
- A connected experience: We prioritize high-touch collaboration and flexibility. Whether you are working from our San Francisco or Phoenix offices or joining us as a fully remote team member, we provide the digital-first tools and intentional culture to keep you synced and supported.

- Invested in your future: A competitive salary and a 401(k) with a 5% company match to help you build long-term financial security.

- Holistic well-being: We provide the resources you need to thrive, from flexible time off and paid parental leave to an annual wellness allowance and comprehensive health coverage.

- Professional & personal growth: Take advantage of a suite of premium perks, including Udemy access, childcare assistance, pet insurance, and a bevy of additional savings through Beneplace.

jobs.title: People Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Your role in our mission
 
Prosper is looking for a talented People Operations Manager to join the People & Places team. This person will oversee HR operations, employee lifecycle processes, and the HR technology stack. This person is data-driven and detail oriented, strives to make processes efficient, and is system savvy. This role reports to our Director, Total Rewards & People Operations, and will have one direct report.

How you’ll make an impact
-
Serve as primary owner and subject matter expert for ADP Workforce Now , partnering with HR leadership and IT to evaluate, roll out, and maintain scalable HR technology roadmaps and integrations.

-
Establish data architecture and governance protocols to safeguard data integrity, streamline administrative workflows, and continuously drive process automation and efficiency.

-
Oversee seamless full-cycle onboarding and offboarding processes , continually evolving system connections and operational touchpoints to deliver an exceptional employee experience.

-
Manage and mentor the People Operations Analyst , ensuring accurate processing of all employee lifecycle changes, as well as administration and tracking of required employee training.

-
Develop and maintain ADP reports, metrics, and dashboards to provide meaningful operational and strategic data to business leaders.

-
Ensure regulatory and legal compliance across city, state, and federal labor laws by overseeing mandatory reporting, compliance training, and internal system audits.

-
Partner on key compensation initiatives , including build of the compensation planning dashboard in ADP, generating merit and promotion letters for compensation cycles, providing data for compensation survey submissions (i.e. Radford McLagan), and providing input for the quarterly pending grant lists for approval by the Comp Committee.

-
Collaborate with Benefits and Payroll teams to configure annual Open Enrollment in ADP, conduct routine system audits, and ensure seamless system setup.

-
Manage HR vendor relationships and process documentation , leading ongoing system monitoring and training stakeholders to ensure sustained tool adoption.

-
Partner with People Operations Analyst and outside immigration counsel to manage Prosper’s immigration program , advising internal stakeholders regarding visa requirements and case processing.
Skills that will help you thrive
-
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field

-
5+ years of HRIS administration experience, including 3+ years direct ADP experience preferred (Workforce Now module a strong plus)

-
Advanced knowledge in HRIS system set up and administration (ADP preferred)

-
Data and process driven, great organizational skills, high attention to detail

-
Strong Excel proficiency and analytical skills

-
Excellent written and verbal communication skills

-
Strong problem-solving skills

-
Effective project management skills
